title: Always-on AI
next: GEO: how to get your business recommended by AI search

lines.vo: Wait. An AI that texts me first? Without me asking anything?
lines.cap: An AI that TEXTS ME FIRST?

lines.vo: That's always-on AI. Agents that keep working in the background, and check in when something needs you.
lines.cap: That's ALWAYS-ON AI. It works in the BACKGROUND.

lines.vo: Okay, I need to understand this. Let's go.
lines.cap: Okay. LET'S GO.

lines.vo: A normal chatbot is reactive. It waits for your prompt, answers, and then it just stops.
lines.cap: A chatbot is REACTIVE. It waits, answers, STOPS.

lines.vo: So if I close the app, nothing happens.
lines.cap: Close the app, NOTHING happens?

lines.vo: Exactly. An always-on agent is proactive. You give it a goal once. It watches for triggers, it acts, and it checks in with you.
lines.cap: An agent is PROACTIVE: GOAL, TRIGGERS, ACT, CHECK IN.

lines.vo: Triggers? Like what?
lines.cap: TRIGGERS? Like what?

lines.vo: A schedule, like every morning at seven. A new email. A change in some data. Anything that says: time to work.
lines.cap: A SCHEDULE. A NEW EMAIL. A DATA CHANGE.

lines.vo: Then it loops. Trigger, think, act, check in. And then it goes back to watching.
lines.cap: TRIGGER, THINK, ACT, CHECK IN. Repeat.

lines.vo: And where is it doing all this? On my laptop?
lines.cap: Where does it run? My LAPTOP?

lines.vo: Usually in the cloud. So you can close your laptop, and it keeps going.
lines.cap: In the CLOUD. Close your laptop, it KEEPS GOING.

scenes.label: QUIZ 1
scenes.question: Your laptop is closed. Where does an always-on agent keep working?

lines.vo: Quiz time! Your laptop is closed. Where does an always-on agent keep working?
lines.cap: QUIZ: laptop closed. Where does it WORK?

lines.vo: Pause the video and guess. A, B, or C.
lines.cap: PAUSE and guess. A, B or C?

lines.vo: It's B, the cloud. Some agents even get their own virtual computer and browser.
lines.cap: B! The CLOUD, on its OWN COMPUTER.

lines.vo: Is this real yet, or just a demo?
lines.cap: Is this REAL yet?

lines.vo: It's real. On September twenty-ninth, OpenAI launched dots. Always-on agents in ChatGPT that work on your goals in the background.
lines.cap: Sept 29: OpenAI launched DOTS.

lines.vo: You can message them in Slack or Teams. OpenAI's example: a developer's dot watches customer feedback, and fixes bugs.
lines.cap: Message them in SLACK or TEAMS.

lines.vo: And Anthropic?
lines.cap: And ANTHROPIC?

lines.vo: In late October, Anthropic previewed Claude Duet. It sends you a morning brief from your email and calendar, and checks your accounts every few hours.
lines.cap: CLAUDE DUET: a MORNING BRIEF, checks every few hours.

lines.vo: It runs on its own cloud computer, with its own browser. For now, it's a preview for Pro and Max users in the US, by waitlist.
lines.cap: Its OWN CLOUD COMPUTER. Preview, US WAITLIST.

lines.vo: So what does a day with one actually look like?
lines.cap: What does a DAY look like?

lines.vo: Seven A.M. Your morning brief. Three meetings, two urgent emails.
lines.cap: 7:00 · Your MORNING BRIEF.

lines.vo: Ten A.M. An invoice email lands, and the agent drafts a reply.
lines.cap: 10:00 · It DRAFTS A REPLY.

lines.vo: But before sending, it asks you. Send this? You tap approve.
lines.cap: SEND THIS? You tap APPROVE.

lines.vo: Oh. So I'm still the boss.
lines.cap: So I'm still THE BOSS.

lines.vo: Exactly. That's the big trade-off. Duet pauses for approval before payments, signing documents, or deleting things.
lines.cap: It PAUSES before PAYING, SIGNING, DELETING.

lines.vo: Some actions stay blocked even if you approve, like moving money. And purchases use a one-time card.
lines.cap: MOVING MONEY stays BLOCKED. ONE-TIME CARDS.

lines.vo: What can still go wrong?
lines.cap: What can GO WRONG?

lines.vo: It can misjudge what's urgent. Emails it reads could try to trick it. And background work still uses your plan's limits.
lines.cap: Misjudged URGENCY. TRICK EMAILS. USAGE LIMITS.

scenes.label: QUIZ 2
scenes.question: Before signing a document for you, an agent should...

lines.vo: Last quiz! Before signing a document for you, an agent should do what?
lines.cap: QUIZ: before SIGNING, it should...

lines.vo: Pause and guess. A, B, or C.
lines.cap: PAUSE and guess. A, B or C?

lines.vo: B. Pause and ask you. Big actions always need your yes.
lines.cap: B! Big actions need YOUR YES.

lines.vo: So: a goal, a trigger, an action, and a check-in.
lines.cap: GOAL. TRIGGER. ACT. CHECK IN.

lines.vo: That's always-on AI. Next up: G.E.O., how to get your business recommended by AI search. Follow so you don't miss it.
lines.cap: Next: GEO. FOLLOW for more.
